projects.title: Featured work
projects.subtitle: Backend and AI systems I built in real products and personal projects.

items.title: RAG Document Analysis System
items.description: End-to-end RAG system for Q&A over PDF documents. Async embedding pipeline with Celery + Redis, BGE + Cross-Encoder reranking, real-time token streaming via SSE.

items.title: AI-Powered Notes App
items.description: Secure JWT-based RESTful API with auto-tagging, summarization and semantic search via OpenAI embeddings. PostgreSQL schema managed with Alembic.

items.title: npm Dependency Graph 3D Analysis
items.description: Tool modeling npm package dependency graphs with NetworkX and presenting them as interactive 3D plots with Plotly. Optimized recursive data fetching.

items.title: Auth Service (Next.js)
items.description: End-to-end authentication service covering registration, login, password reset and session management. Live demo deployed on Vercel.
